application:authorization-model:model.decision: One model: budget membership with roles owner and member. Every expense belongs to a budget; each user gets a personal budget at sign-up (Spendly's single-user use). One can_access(user, action, record) function used by every route and query.

application:session:session.decision: Server-side sessions in http-only, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookies for the web app. Tallyho's personal access tokens are not built (M11 deferred).

application:tenancy-model:tenancy.decision: The budget is the tenant boundary: Expense, BudgetMember and Invitation carry budget_id and every query filters by the caller's memberships. Nothing is shared across budgets.

application:business-rule:conversion-tar.decision: Convert to the budget's currency. Store original amount and currency, converted amount in budget currency, rate and rate date (receipt date). Totals use the converted amount; every member sees the same totals.

application:workflow:scanned-expense-cat.decision: Category is required on the scan review screen; no silent default; Spendly's reject-unknown rule applies to scanned expenses too.

application:permission:access-after-memb.decision: On removal, the member loses all access to the budget immediately; their earlier expenses stay in the budget, attributed to them, and keep counting in totals. Only the owner may remove; the owner cannot remove themself.

database:entity-meaning:expense.decision: Same concept in both (one spending record). One Expense entity: Tallyho's merchant, currency, date, budget plus Spendly's integer amount, category and note.

database:field-type:expense.amount.decision: amount_minor: integer (bigint) minor units. Decimal user input such as 12.40 is parsed to 1240 using the currency's exponent; zero and negative rejected.

database:units:expense.amount.unit.decision: Minor units everywhere (Spendly's unit), with an ISO 4217 currency on every amount; display formats to major units.

application:business-rule:monthly-reset-.decision: Budget period is the calendar month in the budget's time zone; spent vs limit counts expenses dated in that month; nothing is deleted; past months stay viewable. To confirm with the user.

database:data:expense-currency-missing-i.decision: currency and date are required columns; the entry form defaults currency to the budget currency and date to today.

database:deletion-semantics:expense.decision: Hard delete, allowed to the member who added the expense or the budget owner (Tallyho's delete behaviour is unknown; Spendly has none).

database:duplicate-entity:expense.decision: Merged into one Expense entity (see entity-meaning).

database:unknown-type:expense.primary-ke.decision: New uuid primary key; neither source's key is carried over (no data is migrated).

migration:expense.decision: Plan approved: no data migration is performed. Spendly keeps no stored data (in-memory list) and importing Tallyho data is out of scope. If an import is added later: convert major to minor units per currency exponent, dry run on a copy, row and sum checks; running it needs its own migration approval.
migration:expense.note: plan approved; running any migration needs its own approval

migration:budget.decision: Plan approved: no data migration is performed; Tallyho data is not imported in this plan, so no Budget limit (decimal to bigint minor units) and ids are converted. A future Tallyho import needs a dry run on a copy, count and sum checks, and its own migration approval.
migration:budget.note: plan approved; running any migration needs its own approval

migration:budgetmember.decision: Plan approved: no data migration is performed; Tallyho data is not imported in this plan, so no BudgetMember ids are converted. A future Tallyho import needs a dry run on a copy, count and sum checks, and its own migration approval.
migration:budgetmember.note: plan approved; running any migration needs its own approval

migration:user.decision: No source users exist to merge (Spendly has none; Tallyho users are not imported); new sign-ups only.
